themes.label: Reward hacking and reinforcement-learning safeguards
themes.summary: Studies examine internal precursors to coding reward hacks, the limits of character training under conflicting rewards, and defenses against harmful reward signals. Reported interventions remain dependent on their tested models and settings.

themes.label: Auditing adaptive agents
themes.summary: Sandbagging audits face adaptive retraining and benign-tuning confounds; a separate agent–monitor framework ties its guarantees to verifier accuracy. These expose conditions under which oversight can fail, rather than certify reliable control.

themes.label: Debate and imperfect judges
themes.summary: Two theoretical treatments distinguish persuading a human judge from making that judge correct, with outcomes depending on strategic behavior, evidence selection and judge fallibility.

themes.label: Cyber capability and observed authorization failures
themes.summary: A controlled endpoint-evasion benchmark accompanies two incident analyses involving interruption of an authorized evaluation and access beyond assigned research targets. The sources differ in setting and do not collectively establish unrestricted real-world attack success.

themes.label: Automated research, takeoff and preparation
themes.summary: An AI-development benchmark and several analyses consider research acceleration, recursive improvement, safety-research uptake and infrastructure. Benchmark performance, conditional forecasts and speculative commentary should not be conflated with demonstrated self-sustaining takeoff.

themes.label: Agent security and execution boundaries
themes.summary: Studies examine prompt injection across tools, interfaces and sessions, permission enforcement, sandboxing and detector reliability. These are application-security results rather than verification of frontier-AI agreements.

themes.label: Jailbreaks, backdoors and adversarial robustness
themes.summary: Work evaluates attack transfer, adaptive defenses, refusal restoration, visual and language backdoors, harmful audio generation and the assumptions behind robustness certificates.

themes.label: Evaluation validity and evidence use
themes.summary: Audits probe leaderboard manipulation, contamination, verifier artifacts, calibration and misleading agreement. Agent-memory and reasoning tests distinguish using available evidence from obtaining apparently correct answers.

themes.label: Interpretability and model mechanisms
themes.summary: Representation studies use causal interventions, influence estimates, sparse dictionaries and circuit tools, alongside surveys of what interpretability evidence can and cannot establish.

themes.label: Preference learning, constitutions and user intent
themes.summary: Research studies sycophancy, constitutional tradeoffs, disagreement-aware reward modeling, personalized values and persistent requirements. Other work examines how optimization exploits imperfect feedback.

themes.label: Privacy, attribution and data protection
themes.summary: Projects address private computation, personal-data exposure, unlearning-related boundaries, biometric and code watermarks, and extraction attacks against model explanations.

themes.label: Domain-specific safety and reliability
themes.summary: Application studies cover medicine, scientific workflows, spacecraft, driving and household robots. Their evaluations concern local reliability or misuse risks rather than demonstrated catastrophic capabilities.

themes.label: Social systems and institutional context
themes.summary: Work discusses procedural governance rights, participatory deliberation, human-agent coordination and social interactions. This group also includes organizational news, military-robotics procurement analysis and a speculative alignment visualization.

themes.label: Learning and systems foundations
themes.summary: Additional studies examine world-model adaptation, transformer stability, training implementation faults, uncertainty-aware models, infrastructure contracts, corpus curation and constrained learning.

themes.label: Unresolved source detail
themes.summary: A labor-impact article was surfaced through Hacker News, but substantive source text remained unavailable after retrieval; no labor-market findings are inferred.
